text: The field's most persuasive topological-photonics application, demonstrated by Bandres et al. (2018) with a topologically trivial control device built into the experiment for comparison, is the topological insulator ___.
explanation: The topological insulator laser (Bandres et al., 2018) is the field's most persuasive application precisely because the experiment includes a topologically trivial control that the topological device beats, with protection enforcing single-mode lasing over a large gain area that would otherwise support many competing modes.
